[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931902/fb50893e4d715927db3fb695256404e3e1b7fba4.png[/img]
[i]The next update for Jeepney Simulator 2 is here! We've added a ton of new features for you guys to experience and enjoy, including missions, new upgrades, cryptocurrencies, and more! We also wanted to add subtitles to help foreigners understand the intricacies of filipino jeepney culture. We hope you guys have fun with the new update and that you're all having a wonderful holiday week![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931902/f97adde43bff0513628c552cb758574c48697a5f.png[/img]
[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
- MISSIONS: Ready for a challenge? Billy has given you eight missions to prove your worth to the company. Accomplish them for extra pay!
- SUBTITLES: For "Original", and "English"
- NEW VOICELINES (Oreo and Waren) and VOICELINES REWORK
- NEW UPGRADES: Extra seating for the rear and top of your jeep!
- CRYPTOCURRENCIES: In the Billy's Office computer, players can now invest in three unique cryptocurrencies: Billy's Boundary Coin (BBC), symbolizing the strength and consistency of Billy's Boundaries; Stable Hawk Token (SHT), the reliable option from Hawk Industries which is totally not going to do a rug pull; and Counterfeit Unstable Money (CUM), the leading crypto coin symbolizing high risk but high reward. Try your hand at crypto and see where your fortunes land! (Please note: We do not endorse real-world cryptocurrency transactions. This feature is purely a way for players to generate extra income if they need it. We also wanted to satirize certain rugpull scams prevalent in the industry)

notes.title: V1.0.2 - "NOT SAVING"/"STUCK ON 'DAY X'" BUG FIXED + MORE
notes.notes:
With the help of Mocha Oat and our lovely audience, we were finally able to vanquish the dreaded "Stuck on 'Day X'" bug! Apparently, the bug occurred when the players bought a lottery ticket and found a way to delete it in the game (depositing it in Billy's Office, paying it as change, etc.). Whenever the player ends the shift, the lottery system would look for the tickets to delete them, but if they were already deleted, the code would encounter an error, and the loading screen wouldn't go away.

This was one of the worst bugs we've ever encountered, and we never thought it would be from the lottery system. This just goes to show the importance of playtesting and how complex game development can be, even on a seemingly simple game such as Jeepney Simulator 2. Again, we want to thank you all for your help, and please don't hesitate to message us on Facebook if you ever encounter any bugs! 

NEW FEATURES
- "Restart shift" button and deposit amount shown in tablet

CHANGES
- Made MAIA dropoff location clearer
- Increased NPC audio range

FIXES
- Finally fixed Day 2 bug/Lottery ticket bug. See above for details
- Forced notifications for violations
- Fixed damage being too frequent when getting hit by police cars (Now limited to only two hits per second)
- Fixed NPCs still using walk animation when colliding with vehicle
- Fixed Billy's Tips bug
- Fixed infinite money glitch ;)

notes.title: v0.5.4 - CUSTOM DECALS AND TABLET OVERHAUL!
notes.notes:
[i]Hey! While we're working on the next massive update for Jeepney Simulator 2, we wanted to give you guys a few quality of life improvements! We really wanted to make you guys proud after the overwhelming support and love you showed us and our game during this Steam Summer Sale! Jeepney Simulator 2 is only going to get better from here :)[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931902/546b9abb5bc2756a5cb3cb9ea865b868dc0f9f06.png[/img]
[h3]NEW FEATURES[/h3]
[b]TABLET OVERHAUL[/b]
[i]The tablet has been overhauled with a cleaner UI and new QoL features![/i]
[b]CAROUSEL[/b]: The jeepney tablet now has a carousel system. Press the arrow buttons to switch between different pages!
[b]ROTATING MAP[/b]: The long awaited rotating map feature is finally here! When you turn your jeepney, the map POV and texts also rotate with it. This is on by default, so to turn this off, just press the "CAM" (Camera Mode) button on the bottom-left.
[b]ROUTE SELECTION[/b]: Activate and deactivate your landmarks on the go! Make sure that no passengers are left behind in your jeep!
[b]SERVICES[/b]: The services page is where you'll find the towing system. This is where we'll be adding any future services for the player and their jeepney
- Added job applications for other types of work (Cashier, credit card swiper, narrative girl, etc)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931902/a44710e62ee13130d51f00ddd4853e9025819ea9.png[/img]
[h3]EXPERIMENTAL NEW FEATURES[/h3]
[b]CUSTOM DECALS[/b]: Use up to ten of your own images as decals on your jeepney! Learn more in the game's settings panel
[b]AUTO GRAPHICS QUALITY[/b]: When starting the game for the first time or when pressing the associated button in the settings, Jeepney Simuilator 2 will automatically set the correct graphics preset for your game based on the amount of VRAM your PC has. Very Low: 1024 MB, Low: 2048 MB, Medium: 4096 MB, High: > 4096 MB
[b]CRASH FIXER[/b]: For those of you who are experiencing crashing when booting up the game because the default graphics preset is MEDIUM, we've made it so the graphics preset is automatically set when you open the game after a crash
[b]NOTE[/b]: [i]These features are in the game and they are usable, but please keep in mind that due to their complexity, bugs may occur with these system. Please let us know if you encounter any problems so we can further improve and complete these features![/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931902/859bbe4efb849df58b98c374953a3d8f0e874578.png[/img]

- Changed tablet map player indicator color to yellow for better clarity

notes.title: SYSTEMS CHECK
notes.notes:
We're LESS THAN A WEEK away from releasing JEEPNEY SIMULATOR 2 in Steam Early Access!

After weeks of private playtesting, we're finally giving our wider audience a chance to test our game FOR FREE and help with the game's development by providing bug reports and suggestions all while experiencing the game before anyone else.

A lot of improvements were added since JEEPNEY SIMULATOR 1, especially when it comes to making the game feel easier to understand and control. Lots of thought and care went into the design of the fresh, new TUTORIAL, which should help inexperienced players with the game.

For those who want to join the public playtest, simply visit our facebook page and find our latest posts to know how to join. We can't wait to hear from you guys! Happy testing :)
